app_description: <p data-start="42" data-end="323"><strong data-start="0" data-end="15" data-is-only-node="">8 Ball Pool</strong> is a popular mobile billiards game developed by Miniclip. It offers realistic physics, smooth controls, and competitive multiplayer gameplay. Players can challenge friends or compete with others worldwide in 1v1 matches and tournaments. With customizable cues, ranked progression, and various tables to unlock, 8 Ball Pool is fun, addictive, and easy to play anytime, anywhere.</p>
